verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, a ReadMe reference with per-endpoint generated language snippets, a sandbox, and an MCP server. None of it shows an official, vendor-published SDK or client library. Generated request snippets and an OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks that could be used to build a client, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
